*Another PE lesson has come to an end.
Students were leaded back to locker rooms. Abbie sat down on one of the benches and started carefuly undressing along with others, cowering himself with a towel.
Abbie started heading towards showers.
Entering one of the stalls, he closed the curtain and hanged his towel, turned on the shower, now washing off sweat and small dirt from himself... while distracted, someone's arm reached out from other side of the curtain and snatched his towel away...
Only after finishing washing away the filth, he saw that the towel was gone... he thought of asking others to help, but he was too awkward about it... so he just stayed in the stall until everybody left.
When Abbie was sure that the locker room was empty, he left the stall, quickly heading to his locker... his locker was wide open, and all of his clothes missing... including the dirty PE clothes... that was certainly one of the bullies who stole it...*
**Abbie couldnt believe his eyes...**
